title: One Little Lamb, One Sorry Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The prophet Nathan told a tale
About one little sheep,
A rich man took the poor man's lamb,
His only one to keep.

[Chorus]
Say sorry when you've done a wrong,
And try to make it right.
Heavenly Father will forgive,
And hold you close and tight.

[Verse 2]
"That man is wrong!" King David cried.
Then Nathan said, "It's you."
And David wept, "I've sinned, O Lord,
Forgive me, make me new."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and whisper soft
A sorry, if you need.
Heavenly Father hears you, child,
And loves you, yes indeed.

[Chorus]
mood: Cradle music. A soft, slow rocking pulse holds under the voice like arms that stay open while a hard story is told, tender at the moment David's heart breaks, then warmer as forgiveness comes. The chorus lifts gently, the sound of a door that is never locked. By the last verse the rocking slows and sinks lower, a whispered sorry answered with a hug, until it rests.
